title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 07/2019
source: Source: FOB Beyers M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS. Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with very nice sound captures a raw, classic Dead performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a clean, no‑frills audience tape that lets the natural energy of the show shine through. Reviewers describe it as “great” and note that it delivers the old‑fashioned vibe of the band’s touring heyday. While no specific songs are called out, the overall impression is that the performance lives up to the reputation of the greatest touring band ever.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights both a good audience recording and an enjoyable, classic performance; lack of detailed song or member comments limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, raw audience tape with no frills; praised for very nice sound despite being a simple crowd recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a classic, unembellished set that reflects the band’s greatest touring era; no specific issues noted.
